name: stage2-train-cars-v4
title: Stage 2 train-car set pieces: contrast-adaptive shape pass + toned material layer over stage2-train-cars-v3
state: predicted-static; import only after live capture confirms the key (validate_predicted.py confirm + gate on the AQ-01/AQ-03 Stage 2 capture)
method:
W7-STAGE2 train-car per-panel shape pass (lane-s2, claude-einhander).  CPU only, deterministic, nothing generated.

Problem (v2 / v3): the categorical master turns the native low-contrast dither / weathering grain inside the car panels
(isolated 1-3 texel specks of a neighbouring tone) into small hard-edged rounded blobs: a 'melted camouflage' look at 4K.
On the PSX that grain was never a shape; it was tonal mottling.

Pass, per drawn static key (its CLUT), per drawn cell (cell isolation, own texels only):
  grain   4-connected components of equal native COLOUR with <= GRAIN_MAX texels and a bbox <= 2 x 2, low contrast to
          their 3x3 surround (|dL| <= DL_MAX and RGB distance <= DC_MAX), opaque (class 127) with an all-opaque 3x3
          surround, outside the protected lettering rects.  High-contrast specks (rivets, bolts, lamps, arrows, marking
          dashes) and every larger shape keep the categorical render.
  soft    RGB_soft = normalised gaussian (SIGMA_SOFT texels) of the native colours of the cell's opaque texels,
          texel-centred bilinear 8x upsample.
  blend   w = gaussian-feathered (FEATHER texel) grain mask; RGB = v3 + w * (RGB_soft - v2) * factor, factor = the v3
          material layer (frozen/stage2-train-cars-v3/master/<TEX>-material-factor-8x.npz); where w == 0, v4 == v3 bit for bit.
  alpha   bit-identical to v3 (= v2); class re-validated at every native texel centre on re-read.
Protected: 1BC35EBE uv [64,96,128,128] (painted lettering + eye emblem): no shape change in that cell, and the glyph
pixels carry factor 1 (mat_layer glyph protection), so every glyph pixel equals v2 / v3 exactly (checked per build).
v4 option K_LP: the material layer is rebuilt with a weaker large-blotch mottling (k_lp 0.15 -> 0.08), same swatch.
usage: python -I shape_pass.py build <run> | freeze <run> <cfg.json>
supersedes: stage2-train-cars-v3 RGB of all 20 keys (alpha planes bit-identical to v3 / v2). v3 stays untouched.
generated_imagery: none new (swatch grey_deck_v3a from stage2-train-cars-v3 comfy/)
honest_read: Two changes over v3. (1) Contrast-adaptive shape pass: low-contrast native tonal mottling (3x3 max colour distance <= 24, ramp to 48) is rendered as soft tonal variation instead of the categorical master's small hard-edged rounded blobs; panel lines, rivets, hatches, grilles, markings and every high-contrast edge stay crisp categorical. (2) The material layer's large-blotch mottling is toned down (k_lp 0.15 -> 0.08, same swatch, repeat and band limit), so the grime no longer reads as extra camouflage spots painted over hatches (worst on 6C5AC447). Result: the panels read as weathered painted steel with soft paint variation instead of 'melted camo blobs'; grille slats lose the rounded light-blob pattern. Weak points: low-contrast panel interiors are softer than v3 (a mild soft-CG risk on the lightest panels; structure stays crisp, the grime layer keeps fine detail); some large grime blotches remain via the high-pass; the marking cell 1BC35EBE [64,96,128,128] gets no shape change (lettering + emblem untouched: 9106 glyph pixels equal v2/v3 exactly). Brightness is not the gain: mean luminance v4/v3 = 0.999-1.006 per key. Flip-book replay of the logged draws (SIMULATION, 1080p): shimmer below v3 on 17 of 20 keys, median v4/v3 0.971, v4/v2 1.012, v4/stock 0.56; three thin edge-on draws (0F01F0FA-B692B4C2 / 8FD3DE52 / F11578EE) shimmer as much as stock in every version (extreme minification of the replay quads: only mipmaps would fix those).
known_limits: predicted-static: import only after a live Stage 2 capture confirms key and CLUT (validate_predicted.py confirm + gate); area-versioned pages bind only to the 1/26 TEX
the shape weight is computed from each CLUT's native colours (a CLUT-specific RGB pass); class / alpha untouched
no new generated imagery; the material swatch is grey_deck_v3a (stage2-train-cars-v3 comfy/), rebuilt as a factor with k_lp 0.08

flip-book replay uses the sampled draw log (about one record per key per 60 frames) and approximates 3D triangles as parallelograms over the uv bounds: right order, positions and scale, not exact UV mapping
review and replay are SIMULATIONS (bilinear, no mips); no in-game capture exists

failed_experiments.work/shape/s3 (contrast mode, v3 factor): superseded by s4/s5: blob contours softened, but the v3 grime blotches still read as camouflage spots on 6C5AC447
failed_experiments.work/shape/s4: superseded by s5 (s4 copied the whole 1BC35EBE marking cell from v3, so its grime strength differed from the neighbouring quads; s5 relies on the glyph protection instead, glyph pixels still exact)

flipbook_replay_SIMULATION.method: tools/flipbook.py: logged Stage 2 draws (runs A frames >= 39883 and B), real order and quads, T = 6 frames per draw at the measured velocity, 1080p (4.5 px / PSX unit); shimmer = mean |e_t - e_(t-1)|, e = bilinear-no-mip render - 2x2 supersampled reference; versions stock (nearest), v2, v3, v4 candidate (work/shape/s5)

review.note: native | v3 | v4: drawn cells at 2 px/texel, a 16x crop, the biggest cell at 9 px/texel (4K) and 4.5 px/texel (1080p), bilinear, no mips: SIMULATIONS. Flip-book: the logged Stage 2 draws replayed (tools/flipbook.py), shimmer = mean |e_t - e_(t-1)|, e = bilinear-no-mip render - 2x2 supersampled reference, inside the quads; lower is calmer.

class_validation.rule: class at every native texel centre floor((i+0.5)*scale) == classes(CLUT)[words] (0 / 127 / 255); every export re-read from disk; alpha planes bit-identical to the base frozen exports
